sonuclar.tahmin_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM orders;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM customers;

SELECT SUM(price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items
JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
  orders
WHERE 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
  month;

SELECT 
  tc.product_category_name_english AS product_category,
  SUM(oi.price * oi.order_item_id) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  order_items oi
JOIN 
  products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
  product_category_name_translation tc ON p.product_category_name = tc.product_category_name
GROUP BY 
  tc.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY 
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_delivery_percentage
FROM 
  orders;

SELECT c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM customers c
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY customer_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')
AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month');

SELECT AVG(review_score) AS average_review_score
FROM order_reviews;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) FROM sellers;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) AS distinct_product_category_count
FROM products;

SELECT MAX(price) AS max_price
FROM order_items;

SELECT geolocation_state, COUNT(DISTINCT sellers.seller_id) AS seller_count
FROM sellers
JOIN geolocation ON sellers.seller_zip_code_prefix = geolocation.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY geolocation_state;

SELECT payment_installments, COUNT(*) AS frequency
FROM order_payments
WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'
GROUP BY payment_installments
ORDER BY frequency DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    c.customer_city, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_city
ORDER BY 
    total_orders DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    geolocation_state AS state, 
    AVG(price) AS avg_order_value
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
JOIN 
    geolocation ON geolocation.geolocation_state = orders.customer_state
GROUP BY 
    geolocation_state
ORDER BY 
    avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    sellers.seller_id, 
    SUM(order_items.price + order_items.freight_value) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    sellers
JOIN 
    orders ON sellers.seller_id = orders.seller_id
JOIN 
    order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
GROUP BY 
    sellers.seller_id
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::integer AS month,
  SUM(payment_value) AS monthly_revenue
FROM 
  orders
JOIN 
  order_payments ON orders.order_id = order_payments.order_id
WHERE 
  order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' 
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01'
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
  month;

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS day_of_week, 
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM 
  orders
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int
ORDER BY 
  order_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 3600 AS delivery_time_hours,
    geolocation_state
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    geolocation ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
JOIN 
    geolocation ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
ORDER BY 
    delivery_time_hours DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COUNT(order_id) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) > 1 THEN customer_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS percentage_of_multiple_order_customers
FROM 
  orders
JOIN 
  customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id;

SELECT 
  SUM(payment_value) AS total_revenue_last_year
FROM 
  order_payments
JOIN 
  orders ON order_payments.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE 
  orders.order_purchase_timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year'
  AND orders.order_purchase_timestamp < CURRENT_DATE;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_state) FROM customers;

SELECT 
  COUNT(order_item_id) FILTER (WHERE order_items.order_id = orders.order_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_items.order_id) AS avg_freight_value_per_order_item
FROM 
  order_items
JOIN 
  orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id;

SELECT 
  payment_installments::text AS taksit_sayisi,
  AVG(payment_value) AS ortalama_odeme_tutari
FROM 
  order_payments
GROUP BY 
  payment_installments
ORDER BY 
  payment_installments;

SELECT seller_city, COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS seller_count
FROM sellers
GROUP BY seller_city
ORDER BY seller_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT seller_state, COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS seller_count
FROM sellers
GROUP BY seller_state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) > 10;

SELECT 
    t.product_category_name_english,
    AVG(or.review_score) AS avg_score
FROM 
    order_reviews or
JOIN 
    orders o ON or.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN 
    customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN 
    product_category_name_translation t ON c.customer_city = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY 
    t.product_category_name_english
HAVING 
    COUNT(or.review_id) >= 100
ORDER BY 
    avg_score ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN orders.order_delivered_customer_date > orders.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN order_reviews.review_score END) AS avg_delayed_score,
    AVG(CASE WHEN orders.order_delivered_customer_date <= orders.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN order_reviews.review_score END) AS avg_on_time_score
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    order_reviews ON orders.order_id = order_reviews.order_id;

SELECT 
    sellers.seller_state, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS total_orders
FROM 
    orders
JOIN 
    sellers ON orders.seller_id = sellers.seller_id
WHERE 
    orders.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 
    sellers.seller_state
ORDER BY 
    total_orders DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  tc.product_category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
  order_items oi
JOIN 
  products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
  product_category_name_translation tc ON p.product_category_name = tc.product_category_name
GROUP BY 
  tc.product_category_name
ORDER BY 
  order_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
  SUM(price) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE 
  o.customer_id IN (
    SELECT 
      c.customer_id
    FROM 
      customers c
    WHERE 
      c.customer_state = 'SP'
  );

SELECT 
  tc.product_category_name_english, 
  AVG(oi.price) AS avg_shipping_cost
FROM 
  order_items oi
JOIN 
  products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN 
  product_category_name_translation tc ON p.product_category_name = tc.product_category_name
GROUP BY 
  tc.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY 
  avg_shipping_cost DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::integer AS order_month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM 
  orders o
JOIN 
  order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
  order_month;

SELECT SUM(payment_value) AS total_revenue
FROM order_payments
JOIN orders ON order_payments.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE orders.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-10-01' AND orders.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01';

SELECT 
    DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) AS order_date,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM 
    orders
WHERE 
    DATE(order_purchase_timestamp) BETWEEN '2017-11-01' AND '2017-11-30'
GROUP BY 
    DATE(order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
    order_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM AVG((order_approved_at - order_purchase_timestamp) * INTERVAL '1 second')) / 3600 AS average_approval_hours
FROM 
  orders;

    s.seller_id,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.order_delivered_carrier_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp)) / 60) AS avg_delivery_time_minutes
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    sellers s ON o.customer_id = s.seller_id
GROUP BY 
    s.seller_id

    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 10

    avg_delivery_time_minutes DESC

    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
    AVG(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS average_order_value
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY 
    year;

  EXTRACT(DAY FROM AVG((order_estimated_delivery_date - order_delivered_customer_date)::interval)) AS average_days_difference
FROM 
  orders
WHERE 
  order_status = 'delivered';

FROM 
    customers

    geolocation

    customers.customer_zip_code_prefix = geolocation.geolocation_zip_code_prefix

sonuclar.tahmin_sql:
SELECT AVG(price) AS average_order_value
FROM order_items;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id
HAVING COUNT(order_id) > 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id)
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < CURRENT_DATE
  AND o.customer_id NOT IN (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_purchase_timestamp < CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year'
);

SELECT 
    order_id, 
    COUNT(order_item_id) AS item_count
FROM 
    order_items
GROUP BY 
    order_id;

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'), 2) AS percentage_above_average
FROM (
  SELECT 
    o.order_id,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_order_value
  FROM 
    orders o
  JOIN 
    order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE 
    o.order_status = 'delivered'
  GROUP BY 
    o.order_id
) AS delivered_orders
WHERE 
  total_order_value > (SELECT AVG(total_order_value) FROM (
    SELECT 
      SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_order_value
    FROM 
      orders o
    JOIN 
      order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE 
      o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY 
      o.order_id
  ) AS avg_orders);

SELECT
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
  LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS previous_month_order_count,
  ROUND(
    (COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) - LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp))) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 1) OVER (ORDER BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)), 0),
    2
  ) AS percentage_change
FROM
  orders o
WHERE
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
GROUP BY
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY
  month;
